caption:
Ads stop working the day you stop paying for them. A good review keeps selling for years after one buyer paid you once. The slides cover four truths about reviews: they outlive the sale, your replies are read by everyone, ratings are earned at dispatch, and one fake can cost you every real one.

What did your worst review teach you? Every seller has one that stung and then fixed something real. Tell us yours in the comments.

#OnlineSellingIndia #EcommerceIndia #CustomerReviews #SmallBusinessIndia #SellerTips
